description: This file implements a custom UserDetails class for Spring Security, representing authenticated user information including roles, account status, and user attributes.

classes.name: UserDetailsImpl
classes.description: A concrete implementation of Spring Security's UserDetails interface, providing user authentication details including authorities and account status.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Static factory method to create UserDetailsImpl instances from User entities, mapping user roles to authorities.

methods.name: getAuthorities
methods.description: Returns the collection of authorities granted to the user.

methods.name: isAccountNonExpired
methods.description: Indicates whether the user's account is non-expired; always true in this implementation.

methods.name: isAccountNonLocked
methods.description: Indicates whether the user's account is non-locked; always true.

methods.name: isCredentialsNonExpired
methods.description: Indicates whether the user's credentials are non-expired; always true.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the user account is enabled.
